::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
1. Setiap minggu, Senin adalah kelas materi dan Rabu adalah sesi lab tutorial. Tutorial harus diselesaikan pada sesi lab yang dijadwalkan.
2. Tutorial **tidak dinilai** secara langsung, tapi menjadi **prasyarat** untuk Individual Assignment minggu yang sama - pola yang dipelajari di tutorial langsung dipakai ulang di sana.
3. Mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen selama jam sesi lab.
4. Individual Assignment dirilis Senin, dengan tenggat waktu Senin minggu berikutnya (lihat menu Tugas).
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
1. Every week, Monday is the lecture and Wednesday is the tutorial lab session. Tutorials must be completed during the scheduled lab session.
2. Tutorials are **not graded** directly, but serve as a **prerequisite** for that same week's Individual Assignment - the pattern you learn there gets reused directly in it.
3. Students may ask teaching assistants questions during the lab session.
4. Individual Assignments are released on Monday, with a deadline the following Monday (see the Assignments menu).
:::
